description: Meta's Marketing API: Graph API endpoints for creating and managing ads across Facebook, Instagram, Messenger and WhatsApp.
auth_notes: Every call requires an access token (user or app tokens); the specific token flow is not detailed in the sources.
gate_detail: Limited access is granted automatically when adding the Marketing API product but is for development only; production use needs Full access through App Review.
api_scope: Graph API endpoints for campaigns, ad sets, creatives and insights, plus related Conversions, Catalog, Business Management and Commerce APIs; Meta Business SDK listed.
mcp_notes: Meta-hosted remote Ads MCP server for managing Meta ads from AI agents.
blocker_detail: Full access, needed for production apps with live advertisers, requires App Review approval.

evidence.quote: Every Marketing API call requires an access token as a parameter.
Heavily rate-limited per ad account. For development only. Not for production apps running for live advertisers.
Automatically granted when you add the Marketing API product to your app.
The Marketing API is a collection of Graph API endpoints and other features that can be used to help you advertise across Meta technologies.
The server is remote-hosted at `https://mcp.facebook.com/ads` and works with any MCP-compatible AI agent.
